senses.gloss: f. ch. = h.מַתָּנָה , gift, grant, donation.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 153a:3">B. Bath. 153ᵃ</cite> <he>ההיא מ׳ וכ׳</he> a deed of donation in which was written &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 40b:2">Ib. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>דגיטא ודמ׳</he> the protest against a letter of divorce or of donation.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 40b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ טמירתא</he> a deed of donation intended to be kept secret; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M03095"><he>מַתְּנָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="M03097"><he>מַתָּנָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 25:13">Targ. Y. Num. XXV, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 18:17">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XVIII, 17</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 10b:6">Sabb. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>תרתי מ׳ דתורא</he> the priestly portions from two oxen (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:3">Deut. XVIII, 3</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:6:13">Y. Snh. II, end, 20ᵈ</cite> <he>כ״ד מ׳</he> the twenty four priestly gifts, v. <cite ref="K00152"><he>כְּהוּנָּה</he></cite>; a. fr.
